notes.title: 20210710 official reply to evaluation and main content of today's update
notes.content:
Reply

To hxb754001 【Friend Fire】
Right click to aim, release to launch. Generally, it's good to press once. You can think that: right click = "Defend".
If you are over attacking the spider car, you can quickly sprint to any direction. When you get up in the hail of bullets, you can quickly press the right button (Defend and bounce back)

As the red neck level. It's a historical fact that  the master said she won the ceremony.

Recommend to get a dark ending (in Chapter 3, replay 3-7 to dark end and then 4-1)

Recommend to make achievements (if it's not difficult)

To Ravenknight [actual mechanism]
About Game Feel: You can try more to press space and interrupt combos
It's not complicated. If the orange dragon explodes, it's a dark ending. If the orange dragon doesn't explode, it's a light ending
